rep_ranges_note: rep_ranges_by_bucket maps a rep target (e.g. '10', '12/side', 'MAX', 'myo', 'time', 'same-as-partner') to the number of assumed sets prescribed at that target in the block's training weeks; per-set pyramids such as '12/10/8/8' contribute one set to each listed target.
counting_convention: Assumed sets: blank Sets on rows 2-3 of a Part inherit the Part's first-row set count (superset/tri-set; reps cell often says 'Superset - same reps'); 'Accumulate'/total-rep targets = 3 bouts; complexes split into components each credited the round count; no set count in a day-Part = 3. As-written: blank = 0. OPTIONAL PIECE OLY excluded from main totals (reported separately). Buy-outs/cardio = bouts, not sets. Muscle credit 1.0 prime / 0.5 synergist (resistance + core only); AP_* sets reported as athletic exposure separately. Lower-body contacts = sets x reps (x2 per side) on lower AP_PLYO + AP_JUMP_LIMITED_KNEE; throws = sets x reps (x2 per side) on AP_THROW.

programs.title: BASEBALL (3 blocks, 24 week-grids)
programs.goal: Baseball athlete annual cycle: off-season build -> pre-season intensify (deload) -> in-season maintain; rotational power, speed, unilateral strength.
programs.progression_summary: Block 1: Resistance sets/wk 72 -> 68 -> 72 -> 72 -> 64 -> 76 -> 78 -> 0; all sets/wk 108 -> 105 -> 105 -> 110 -> 100 -> 108 -> 115 -> 24. Flat set counts (Part C/D = 4); progression via rep scheme (12/10/8/8 -> 12/10/10/8 -> 12/10/10/10), exercise difficulty, and Oly 4x8@75% (wk6) -> 4x6@80% (wk7). wk 8 = recovery (arm care + 'Paced Cardio - easy'). | Block 2: Resistance sets/wk 76 -> 74 -> 75 -> 76 -> 78 -> 81 -> 84 -> 58; all sets/wk 122 -> 118 -> 120 -> 120 -> 136 -> 144 -> 151 -> 82. Ramp: Part C/D sets 4 -> 5 in wk 6-WEEK 8 (resistance +2.6%, +3.8%, +3.7% week over week), main-lift reps drop to 8/6/4/4, 6/6/5/4, 6/6/6/6 and 5x'5 of each' complexes; Oly 4x8@75% -> 4x6@80% -> 4x6@85% -> 4x4@90%; DELOAD WEEK = 3 x 8 everywhere, no buy-out, no Oly (resistance -31%, all sets -46%). | Block 3: Resistance sets/wk 72 -> 76 -> 76 -> 72 -> 68 -> 72 -> 64 -> 76; all sets/wk 120 -> 122 -> 128 -> 129 -> 120 -> 109 -> 119 -> 123. In-season: flat 4 sets, main lifts 4x8 (wk1-2), 10/10/8/8 (wk3), 4x10 (wk4-8); Oly removed; buy-out '1x 30 Sec Fast Run' each day (wk1-4) then single 10-15 cal sprints; speed vs strength main lift alternates Mon/Thu week to week.
